title: A String method that calls itself
hints: The tests don't even run: go vet, which go test runs first, reports that the Sprintf call makes String call itself.
%v on a value with a String method calls that String method. Inside String, that means String calls String forever.
Convert to the underlying type first so fmt formats a plain float: fmt.Sprintf("%.1f°C", float64(c)). The precision also gives the single decimal place the tests want.
